evidence: deepseek: "if p1_list[i] + p2_list[i] > T"; gpt-oss: "p1 + p2 > T" and "if sum1 > T"; qwen: "if p1 + p2 > T"; glm: "if p1 + p2 > T" and "if sum1 > T"
affordance_in_statement: Rule 1 restricts all selected integers to the universe {1, 2, ..., T}; Rule 2 requires sets in one collection to be mutually disjoint; Rule 3 requires S1,k and S2,k to form an ordered contiguous block.
removal_suggestion: There is no task-preserving wording change that removes this affordance: finite-universe cardinality, disjointness, and ordered contiguity intrinsically imply the tested inequalities. Removing it would require changing the set semantics or the contradiction task.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Tests the necessary job capacity inequality, then the collection-1 total capacity inequality.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: Rule 1's finite universe combined with Rule 3's ordered contiguous union and Rule 2's within-collection disjointness.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Checks p1+p2 against T for each job and accumulates collection totals against T.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: All selected integers lie in {1, 2, ..., T}, while relevant sets must consume distinct elements.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Uses p1+p2>T for JOB and total_p1/total_p2>T for LOAD.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The contiguous ordered job union has p1+p2 elements, and mutually disjoint collection sets have a summed cardinality.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Records the first job whose combined size exceeds T, otherwise checks summed collection loads.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: Rule 1 supplies only T available integer positions, so required distinct cardinalities cannot exceed T.

common_affordance: The rules reduce certificate validity to direct pigeonhole comparisons between required distinct set cardinalities and the universe size T.
recommended_edit: No task-preserving edit can defeat all survivors: the direct inequalities are a structural consequence of the immutable set/cardinality rules. A genuinely effective edit would have to change the scenario or certificate task so validity is not determined solely by these cardinality contradictions.
